text:
alex: Heads-up — we're running 'ChaosFest' this Saturday 03:00-07:00 UTC. High-level: rolling failovers across two regions, a pass of the new fallback routing logic, and a quick SLA/SLO tuning exercise. Goal is to validate graceful degradation paths and measure p95/p99 under failover. Please read the runbook and flag any blockers. :mega:

maria: Thanks — which pools will be targeted? will Dedicated customers be touched?

alex: Only non-prod and preprod Dedicated pools for the rolling failovers. Prod will see controlled, small-scale routing exercises (no full pool drains). Dedicated customers with explicit reserved capacity won't be evicted. We'll test fallback routing from primary -> secondary model variants and region fallback at the edge.

jamal: What should alerting thresholds be adjusted to during the window? I want to avoid a flood of noisy pages.

alex: Good call. Plan: temporarily raise burn-rate alert from 1.5x to 3x for the window, silence non-actionable alert channels, and set a short-lived p99 latency page if sustained >5s for 5m. Non-critical dashboards will keep collecting data. Ops: please apply silences 15m before start.

lisa_ops: PSA — I'm pausing automated scaling policies for the window to avoid unexpected instance churn. Also shifting oncall handoff so two folks overlap 02:30-08:30 UTC.

maria: Runbook link? want to double-check kv cache warmup step and prefix whitelists.

alex: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/chaosfest-2025 (shortlink). Key snippet for kv cache warmup:

```
# warmup prefix list
POST /admin/kv/warmup
{
  "prefixes": ["/models/redwood-prod/", "/models/cacheable/"],
  "threads": 20,
  "duration_sec": 300
}
```

alex: Note: warmup is run AFTER each failover step to ensure KV coldstart doesn't blow tail latency.

jamal: For rollback: what are the quick indicators we flip to force immediate fallback to baseline routing?

alex: Quick rollback plan: 1) set routing.policy=baseline in control plane; 2) disable secondary routing in the edge via feature flag; 3) scale up baseline pools by +20% if needed. I'll paste commands in the runbook with one-click rollback buttons for Dedicated customers.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: ChaosFest start in 24h (will send in #eng-sre 60m before).

lisa_ops: I noticed one dependent infra change (tls cert rotation) scheduled same weekend in infra-team calendar. Ops and infra discussing now — will move cert rotation if overlap risk shows.

maria: One more: can we mark the Analytics ingestion pipeline as read-only during the window? avoids churn from eval jobs.

alex: Yes — adding as action item.

jamal: I'm adding a temporary run of the failure injector locally to exercise token-caching paths. Sharing command for visibility:

```
./injector --target=edge-router --mode=failover --rate=2/s --duration=15m
```

alex: Nice. If any team needs a scoped exception (eg long-running jobs), DM me or @lisa_ops. We'll run the first two failover steps as a canary at 03:00 and pause for verification, then continue.

lisa_ops: All good from my side. Ops will publish the post-run TL;DR in #eng-sre with quick metrics (p95/p99, error-rate, token-cost delta).

alex: Thanks everyone. Please ACK if you reviewed the runbook and have no blockers. :thumbsup:

maria: ack :thumbsup:

jamal: ack

lisa_ops: ack

alex: Closing loop — oncall during window: jamal (primary), maria (secondary). Contact via phone if page flood, otherwise DMs first.

sre-bot: Thread pinned to channel by alex.
